notes.title: Demo Updates!
notes.content:
HUGE thank you to everyone who submitted feedback, especially those who filled out the survey!

This update contains the following fixes and features:


press SPACE to switch between the scene and the conclusion screen
DRAG and DROP to organize words in the word bank
click and hold the SKIP button to skip the new intro video
click the LIGHT BULB icon on the conclusion screen to access hints or highlight which blanks are wrong
fixes bug where some players had to reset their progress twice to clear out all levels
fixes typo on Level 1


Keep your feedback coming!
